name: Roll Call @ Hamburger Mary's West Hollywood Location
UN-HINGED: A Dark Comedy Event
description: UNHINGED: A Dark Comedy Event isn't just another comedy show---it's a full-throttle ride to the edge of humor. Step into a space where comedians fearlessly explore the thoughts most people only dare to think, never say out loud. This is your chance to embrace your dark side, challenge your perspective, and laugh at the beautifully inappropriate. Nothing is off-limits. Nothing is safe... except your right to laugh. Prepare for a night of fearless comics delivering bold, intelligent, unapologetic comedy that pushes boundaries, sparks conversation, and reminds us that sometimes the truth hurts---but it's still hilarious. Hold on tight as we take you on a thrill-filled comedy adventure packed with outrageous punchlines, shocking observations, and unforgettable moments. All is fair in Love, War & Comedy. Brace for impact... because once the laughter starts, there's no turning back. Trigger Warning: This show contains dark, edgy, and provocative comedy. These sellers are not affiliated with us and often charge inflated prices. All tickets purchased through our official site are WILL CALL ONLY --- they will not be emailed to you. You will receive a confirmation email after your purchase, and your tickets will be available for pick-up at the door on the night of the show. We will never ask you to call a 1-800 number. If you have any questions, please call us directly at 562-202-9944. Our ONLY authorized ticketing partner is TicketWeb, which is linked directly from our website: TheStandUpClub.com. Ticket resale is strictly prohibited. Tickets suspected of being purchased for the sole purpose of resale may be canceled at the discretion of The Stand Up Club. To ensure your tickets are valid, always purchase directly from TheStandUpClub.com or TicketWeb.com. Stay safe. Don't get scammed.

name: Tower Of Power: Holidays & Hits

Formed in Oakland in 1968, the band defined its sound on East Bay Grease and signed to Warner Brothers, turning out hits like You're Still A Young Man, Down to The Nightclub, So Very Hard to Go, and What Is Hip? Five decades and a world of stages later, those window-rattling grooves and that raucous party spirit still hit just as hard. Get ready for a night of Oakland Soul!
